about: Eventbrite: discover public events by city, category and date, with venues, prices, event URLs, ticket info and organizer listings.

commands.summary: List upcoming events in a place, filtered by category tag and date range. Returns name, URL, date, venue and lowest price.

params.name: placeId
params.description: Eventbrite place id of the city (San Francisco = 85922583).

params.name: tag
params.description: Category tag. Examples: EventbriteCategory/102 = Science & Tech, EventbriteSubCategory/2004 = High Tech, EventbriteCategory/101 = Business, EventbriteSubCategory/1001 = Startups & Small Business.

commands.summary: Home-page event feed for a place: all upcoming, today, or this weekend.

params.name: placeId
params.description: Eventbrite place id of the city (San Francisco = 85922583).

commands.summary: Event page details: title, description, start/end time, image and canonical URL.

params.name: slug
params.description: Last path part of the event URL, e.g. some-title-tickets-1234567890.

commands.summary: Ticket prices and availability for an event: min/max price, free, sold out, sales window.

params.name: eventId
params.description: Numeric event id (the number at the end of the event URL).

params.name: organizationId
params.description: Organization id of the event's organizer (primary_organizer.organization_id in search results).

commands.summary: Events similar to a given event, with dates, venue and formatted price.
An organizer's upcoming events from a date, soonest first.

params.name: organizerId
params.description: Organizer id (number in /o/... URL or primary_organizer_id).

commands.summary: An organizer's past events, newest first.
Organizer track record: years hosting, total events, attendees hosted, verified/badge.
Demand signals for an event, e.g. goingFast, fewTickets, salesEndSoon.
Place Eventbrite infers from the caller's IP: placeId, city name and slug.
